discovery.title: Global heat stuck on high. Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured.
discovery.summary: Earth cooked to its hottest month on record in August, blowing far past a key climate threshold, due to the dangerous double whammy of human-caused climate change and a supersized El Niño, according to the European climate service Copernicus.
